newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-KONSEL FEE RISES IF ROMA WANT HIM NOW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KONSEL FEE RISES IF ROMA WANT HIM NOW.

text.p: Rapid Vienna want 10 million schillings ($811,000) from AS Roma for the immediate signature of goalkeeper Michael Konsel.
"The sooner Konsel is needed, the more expensive he becomes," Rapid manager Werner Kuhn said of the Austrian international on Friday.
But Kuhn said his club would lower the fee to four million schillings ($324,000) if Konsel served three months notice.
Although Konsel has been talking with Roma for some weeks, Kuhn said the Italian club had still not officially made contact with Rapid.
The Austrian league season begins on Tuesday.
